# @arki/theme

> Light, dark and system theme for React: a provider, a `useTheme` hook, and an inline script that applies the stored theme before first paint.

## Import paths
<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/theme`: Light, dark and system theme for React: `ThemeProvider` and the `useTheme` hook. `ThemeProvider`, `useTheme`; types `ResolvedTheme`, `Theme`, `ThemeProviderProps`, `UseThemeReturn`.
- `@arki/theme/script`: Inline script that applies the stored theme before first paint, so the page does not flash. `THEME_STORAGE_KEY`, `themeDetectionFn`, `themeScript`; types `ThemeDetectionOptions`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite
- `useTheme()` outside a provider returns `theme: undefined`; it does not throw.
- `setTheme` of a name not in `themes` stores `defaultTheme`.
- Give the script and the provider the same options, or the page flashes.
- The server renders `defaultTheme`; put `suppressHydrationWarning` on `<html>`.
